hypothesis: When session token expires or recovery key is rotated, background sync replay in useBackgroundSync receives 401 responses. Because retryCount is incremented without pausing, requests exceed MAX_RETRIES (3) and are silently dequeued from IndexedDB, destroying the user's offline-created itineraries and expenses.

Lacking an in-place session re-anchoring mechanism forces users on desynced devices to click logout, triggering localStorage.clear() and wiping all offline data. Conversely, naive re-authentication without asserting res.user_id === current_uuid allows a different user's key to contaminate and overwrite the existing local database.

Concurrent 401 responses from multiple SWR hooks fire tabiji:session_reauth_required repeatedly without debouncing, inducing state thrashing and double-submit race conditions that exhaust backend rate limits.
